description.value: Valley Motel is a 29-room, two-storey motel situated directly on Highway 3 in Sparwood, in the heart of the Elk Valley coal-mining region of BC's Kootenays. The property shares a building with the Arrowana Restaurant, an award-winning Chinese and Western cuisine eatery that has been a local favourite. Sparwood sits on a key Crowsnest Pass touring corridor, making this an accessible and convenient overnight stop for cyclists traversing the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms the motel is a real, operating 29-room property at 601 Pine Ave, Sparwood, on Highway 3. Phone (1-800-918-9305) and address match OSM exactly. Free WiFi is explicitly confirmed ('Free Wifi and Cable TV'). The on-site Arrowana Restaurant serves evening meals. No mention anywhere of bike storage, laundry, tools, or other cyclist-specific amenities. The area page references 'Coal Miner Days June 13-15, 2014', suggesting the website is old, but the motel appears still operational based on OSM looks_closed=false and a functional website.
concerns: Website content appears dated — the area page references 'Coal Miner Days June 13-15, 2014', suggesting the site has not been updated in over a decade. Core contact details still match OSM so likely still operating, but amenity information may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel on a major touring corridor with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. No grounds for exclusion.
